pages.text: Build your first ore doubler with Create, the core of the Tier 1 $(bold)Engineering$() lane.$(br2)Create is the T1 tech mod. Rotational power, automated crafting, and item transport are all available from the start.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Your first automation engine. Brass is the T1 ceiling material, and you bank Tier 1 tokens by submitting Create machines to the Codex.$(br2)$(bold)In IridescentCraft:$() You need brass all through T1. Mechanical Crafters automate the bulk crafting behind Codex submissions, and the Deployer can work an enchanting table for you.

$(bold)What's gated:$() Nothing. All of Create is open from Tier 1.$(br2)$(bold)What's recommended:$() Build a brass auto-crafter early. Brass costs run higher than vanilla Minecraft would lead you to expect, so plan for it.$(br2)$(bold)Artificer synergy:$() The Artificer's Efficient Engineering passive speeds up machines, so a T1 Artificer can run very efficient Create lines.

$(bold)No book needed.$() Create has an in-world $(bold)Ponder$() system: hover any Create block in JEI and hold $(bold)W$() to open an animated tutorial. It is some of the best in-game documentation in any mod.$(br2)$(bold)Next: follow $(l:icraft:engineering/t1_ore_doubling)T1: Ore Doubling$(/l) and put your first millstone to work.$()
